additionalRemarks._instruction: Enter any additional remarks concerning this raster volume sequence.

capturedWith._instruction: Add the device used to capture this raster volume sequence.

coordinateFramework._instruction: Add the coordinate space in which this raster volume sequence exists.

dataLocation._instruction: Add the location of the file or file bundle in which the raster volume sequence is stored.

name._instruction: Enter a descriptive name of this raster volume sequence preferably matching the filename.

numberOfPlanes._instruction: Enter the number of planes in this raster volume sequence.

numberOfVolumes._instruction: Enter the total number of volumes in this sequence (at least two).

temporalSamplingFrequency._instruction: Enter the rate at which consecutive volume are captured in a sequence, preferably measured in Hertz (Hz).

voxelSize._instruction: Enter the physical voxel size for this raster volume sequence (in x,y,z order).
